meta.title: Mia · Contributors
meta.description: Mia contributors: developers, helpers, translators, designers, and everyone who pitched in.

funciones: Full-stack architecture and development of the Mia ecosystem in TypeScript/Node.js: Discord.js bot, REST API (Express), workers, automations, and production backend services.
Deep integration with the Epic Games / Fortnite platform (MCP, EOS, device auth, XMPP/STOMP, STW and BR profiles) and multi-account flows with secure credential handling.
Mia Launcher desktop product (Tauri + SvelteKit): Discord/Epic auth, STW/BR panels, feature parity with the bot, and signed update channel.
Mia Website and Mia Pocket web products: multi-locale site (Cloudflare Pages), mobile dashboard, i18n, and public/private API consumption.
End-to-end infrastructure and operations: MongoDB/Mongoose, deployment, rate limiting, observability, secrets security, and ongoing maintenance of the full Mia stack.
Development and maintenance of the Discord bot in TypeScript/Node.js (Discord.js): slash/prefix commands, event handlers, runtime modules, and internal service structure.
Data layer and persistence with MongoDB/Mongoose: schemas, controllers, and account/user/config logic that powers the bot in production.
Support for the bot's Fortnite systems (fnbr/EOS integrations, party/mission utilities, and automations) with a focus on stabilizing regressions when critical flows fail.
Production debugging and hardening: incident diagnosis, performance/reliability fixes, and ongoing maintenance of shared bot code.
Involvement from Mia's origin alongside the founder: initial bot bootstrap and the project's first databases.
Modeling and curation of STW hero and schematic data (structures, catalogs, and persistence used by bot commands and inventory).
Information extraction via web scraping of public sources to populate and maintain hero, schematic, and related metadata datasets.
Early creative contributions to the product (visual assets and STW rotation content) aligned with the bot's data documentation.
Technical mentoring for the team on MongoDB: document modeling, queries, indexes, and persistence patterns applied to the Discord bot.
Migration of commands and systems from local JSON databases to MongoDB, unifying storage and data access in production.
Collaboration on the STW schematics command and domain: data structures, queries, and flows that power builds/perks and related inventory.
Knowledge transfer on the bot's data architecture so the team could maintain and extend the Mongo layer independently.
External collaboration in Mia's early stages: code contributions and technical knowledge transfer to the internal bot team.
Reverse engineering of third-party clients and services to reconstruct data structures, contracts, and reusable flows for Mia integrations.
HTTP(S) traffic analysis of Epic Games with Fiddler: capturing endpoints, headers, and payloads to document and implement APIs consumable by the bot.
Contributions to the AutoKick system (mission monitoring via XMPP/party state, automated leave, and related flows) and support for other STW bot automations.
Support for the official server (Mia Lounge) support-ticket system: flows, automations, and day-to-day operations maintenance.
Day-to-day bug fixing in Mia: diagnosing user-reported incidents and applying targeted patches to bot commands/systems.
Collaboration with the team to stabilize real-usage-sensitive features (e.g. account registration and related support flows).
